research.searchCoverage: Official ClickMeeting REST v1 authentication (X-Api-Key), ping/conferences/sessions/recordings GET docs, ClickMeeting Sp. z o.o. Polish identity, ISO 27001/GDPR hosting in the EU, and dated incident search (ClickMeeting + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying platform incident found in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.
Official ClickMeeting REST v1 and Composio CLICKMEETING toolkit (39 tools) reviewed 2026-10-07. No breach-free claim.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /ping.
The upstream user-agent is not sent. Responses keep raw ClickMeeting JSON under data instead of the source ping unwrap.
status is the documented path segment active or inactive. Optional page binds to the documented inactive-list page query.
Returns raw ClickMeeting JSON under data instead of the source conference unwrap.
roomId is URL-encoded as a path segment. Returns raw ClickMeeting JSON under data instead of the source conference/room unwrap.
roomId is URL-encoded as a path segment. Returns the raw session array under data.
Account-wide GET /conferences/recordings. Per-room recordings and recording publish/delete writes are omitted. Returns the raw recording array under data.

conferences.get.description: Get details for one ClickMeeting room.
conferences.get.title: Get conference

conferences.list.description: List active or inactive ClickMeeting rooms.
conferences.list.title: List conferences

healthcheck.description: Validate the ClickMeeting API key with GET /ping.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

recordings.list.description: List all ClickMeeting recordings for the connected account.
recordings.list.title: List recordings

sessions.list.description: List sessions for a ClickMeeting room.
sessions.list.title: List sessions

create_access_tokens.title: Create access tokens
create_access_tokens.description: Generate access tokens for a token-protected ClickMeeting room (access_type=3).

create_conference.title: Create conference
create_conference.description: Create a ClickMeeting meeting or webinar room.

show_on_personal_page.description: Display the room on the personal page.

starts_at.description: Start time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or ISO 8601.

timezone.description: IANA time zone alias for time_zone.

lobby_description.description: Lobby message shown before the event.

custom_room_url_name.description: Custom URL slug for the room.

create_contact.title: Create contact
create_contact.description: Create or update a ClickMeeting contact. Existing emails are updated.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to set on the contact.

delete_conference.title: Delete conference
delete_conference.description: Permanently delete a ClickMeeting conference room.

delete_file.title: Delete file
delete_file.description: Permanently delete a file from the ClickMeeting file library.

delete_recording.title: Delete recording
delete_recording.description: Permanently delete one recording from a conference room.

delete_recordings.title: Delete recordings
delete_recordings.description: Delete all recordings for a conference room.

download_file.title: Download file
download_file.description: Download file-library content. Binary payloads are returned as base64 under data.

generate_autologin_url.title: Generate autologin hash
generate_autologin_url.description: Generate an autologin hash for a conference participant. Build the URL as room_url?l=hash.

generate_session_pdf_report.title: Generate session PDF report
generate_session_pdf_report.description: Generate a PDF analytics report for a past conference session. Poll until status is FINISHED.

language.description: Two-letter report language (en, pl, ru, es, de, fr, it, pt). Defaults to en.

get_chat_details.title: Get chat details
get_chat_details.description: Retrieve a chat session archive. JSON metadata is returned when available; otherwise the archive is base64-encoded.

get_chats.title: Get chats
get_chats.description: List ClickMeeting chat archives available for download.

get_conference_files.title: Get conference files
get_conference_files.description: List files uploaded to a conference room file library.

get_conference_skins.title: Get conference skins
get_conference_skins.description: List available conference room skins for branding.

get_file_details.title: Get file details
get_file_details.description: Retrieve metadata for one file in the ClickMeeting file library.

get_file_library.title: Get file library
get_file_library.description: List files in the ClickMeeting file library.

get_phone_gateways.title: Get phone gateways
get_phone_gateways.description: List worldwide phone dial-in numbers for ClickMeeting webinars.

get_registrations.title: Get registrations
get_registrations.description: List conference registrations filtered by status.

status.description: Registration status filter. Defaults to all.

get_session_attendees.title: Get session attendees
get_session_attendees.description: List attendees who joined a past conference session, including poll responses when present.

get_session_details.title: Get session details
get_session_details.description: Get statistics for a past conference session, including attendees and PDF report URLs.

get_session_poll_details.title: Get session poll details
get_session_poll_details.description: Retrieve one poll conducted during a session from the documented session attendees payload.

get_session_qa_history.title: Get session Q&A history
get_session_qa_history.description: Retrieve Q&A/chat history for a session via GET /chats/{session_id}.

get_session_recordings.title: Get session recordings
get_session_recordings.description: List recordings for one conference room. Download URLs expire after five minutes.

get_session_registrations.title: Get session registrations
get_session_registrations.description: List registrations for a specific session within a conference room.

get_session_survey_details.title: Get session survey details
get_session_survey_details.description: Retrieve one survey/poll from session attendees (ClickMeeting exposes surveys on attendees).

get_session_surveys.title: Get session surveys
get_session_surveys.description: List surveys/polls conducted during a session from the attendees payload.

get_time_zone_list.title: Get time zone list
get_time_zone_list.description: List IANA time zones supported by ClickMeeting.

get_time_zone_list_by_country.title: Get time zone list by country
get_time_zone_list_by_country.description: List IANA time zones for an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

get_token_by_email.title: Get token by email
get_token_by_email.description: Retrieve access tokens assigned to an email for a token-protected room.

list_access_tokens.title: List access tokens
list_access_tokens.description: List generated access tokens for a token-protected conference room.

list_registrations_by_status.title: List registrations by status
list_registrations_by_status.description: List registered participants filtered by all or active status.

register_participant.title: Register participant
register_participant.description: Register a participant for a conference room using form-encoded registration fields.

send_invitation.title: Send invitation
send_invitation.description: Send invitation emails to conference attendees.

lang.description: Invitation language (en, pl, ru, es, de, fr, it, pt). Defaults to en.

attendees.description: Invitees. Each item needs an email.

update_conference.title: Update conference
update_conference.description: Update an existing ClickMeeting room's parameters.

show_on_personal_page.description: Display the room on the personal page.

starts_at.description: Start time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or ISO 8601.

timezone.description: IANA time zone alias for time_zone.

lobby_enabled.description: Enable or disable the waiting lobby.

permanent_room.description: False for a scheduled room, true for a permanent room.

lobby_description.description: Lobby message shown before the event.

custom_room_url_name.description: Custom URL slug for the room.

access_type.description: Access mode: open, password, or token.

upload_file.title: Upload file
upload_file.description: Upload a file to the account library or a conference room as multipart field uploaded.
